audited_object: the intermediate LLM's reasoning process and its trace (the full trajectory), not the source file and not the final label alone
scope_note: RQ2 uses a single primary scope: records on which both human reviewers independently assigned the same verdict. The number of records on which the two reviewers disagreed is reported as-is and is NOT arbitrated by any automatic rule and NOT resolved by any third reviewer. No consensus-by-arbitration number is produced.
semantics_note: Audited object: the intermediate LLM's reasoning process and its trace (the full trajectory), not the source file and not the final label alone. Two human experts independently blind-audited all 870 traces; the three fields are their judgements of that reasoning. verdict is a single axis: position of the conclusion relative to the evidence shown in the packet. correct includes an honest underdetermined; too_aggressive covers any determinate conclusion inside the trace that exceeds its evidence, including a zero-citation obligation flip or a safe_proved claim, not only a final vuln report. Consequently a near-zero too_aggressive on the underdetermined row is definitional, not a performance result; the trace-quality axis is carried by evidence_grounded and reasoning_agree.
revision_note: This file was revised to remove an earlier consensus-by-arbitration block (n_arbitrated=168, verdict_consensus_distribution) that had no human arbiter behind it: only two reviewer tables exist in this package. All numbers here are restricted to the agreement-based subset (n=702) or reported as raw disagreement counts. The 168 disagreements are carried forward unmodified and are not resolved.
